{"files":{"fixtures/pinned-reference.json":"{\n  \"image\": \"kreynoldsf5/vesctl@sha256:6ef8dc145b53130273bca4d3400ff9349e057ae36ed8e36d943eb1465e7edd82\",\n  \"version\": \"0-2-24\",\n  \"location\": \"string:\"\n}\n","fixtures/synthetic-inputs.json":"{\n  \"ambiguous.p12\": \"\",\n  \"ec-key.pem\": \"\",\n  \"ec-protected.pem\": \"\",\n  \"ec.p12\": \"\",\n  \"ec.pem\": \"\",\n  \"expired.pem\": \"\",\n  \"rsa-key.pem\": \"\",\n  \"rsa-protected.pem\": \"\",\n  \"rsa.p12\": \"\",\n  \"rsa.pem\": \"\",\n  \"wrong-chain.pem\": \"\"\n}\n","spec/conformance.json":"{\n  \"version\": 1,\n  \"protocol\": [\n    \"independent-go-rust-reference-recovery\",\n    \"randomized-output\",\n    \"tamper-failure\",\n    \"wrong-policy-failure\",\n    \"uint64-policy-boundary\",\n    \"complete-exponent\",\n    \"inclusive-size-limits\"\n  ],\n  \"normalization\": [\n    \"pem-whitespace\",\n    \"pem-pkcs1-pkcs8\",\n    \"protected-pkcs8\",\n    \"modern-p12\",\n    \"exactly-one-p12-key\",\n    \"key-pair-match\",\n    \"leaf-first-chain\",\n    \"chain-signatures\",\n    \"validity\",\n    \"rsa-2048-8192\",\n    \"ec-p256-p384\"\n  ],\n  \"lifecycle\": [\n    \"initial\",\n    \"empty-plan\",\n    \"restart\",\n    \"metadata-edit\",\n    \"renewal\",\n    \"context-rotation\",\n    \"inline-reorder\",\n    \"saved-plan-change\",\n    \"write-only-version\",\n    \"import\",\n    \"drift\",\n    \"deletion\",\n    \"conflict\",\n    \"uncertain-write\",\n    \"missing-provenance\",\n    \"algorithm-cutover\"\n  ],\n  \"qualification\": [\n    \"secret-absence\",\n    \"independent-install\",\n    \"two-way-ciphertext-handoff\",\n    \"all-inline-nodes\",\n    \"linux-macos\",\n    \"live-status-valid\",\n    \"strict-trust-hostname\",\n    \"served-fingerprint\",\n    \"https-success\",\n    \"renewal-propagation\",\n    \"cleanup\"\n  ]\n}\n","spec/v1.md":"# Native Blindfold contract, version 1\n\nAll binary lengths are unsigned 32-bit big-endian. Integers are unsigned big-endian. The envelope\ncontains, in order: length-prefixed UTF-8 canonical tenant ID; uint32 key version; uint64 policy ID;\nalgorithm byte 2; length-prefixed minimally encoded complete public exponent; length-prefixed\nminimally encoded modulus; length-prefixed modulus-width wrapped block; AES-256-GCM ciphertext\nfollowed by its 16-byte tag. The textual location is `string:///` followed by standard padded base64.\n\nFor policy ID `p` and exponent `e`, the effective exponent is `e * (2*p + 2^31 + 1)` without machine\ninteger truncation. Generate a random block of modulus byte width minus two. Set bytes 0 through 3\nto `de ad be ef`. Bytes 4 through 15 are the GCM nonce and bytes 16 through 47 are the AES key. The\nremaining bytes stay random. Wrap the unsigned block by modular exponentiation with the effective\nexponent and modulus. Use empty GCM additional authenticated data. Encryption is randomized.\n\nInputs and public documents have a 2 MiB inclusive limit. Final encoded certificate and encrypted\nlocations, including their prefix, have a 131072-byte inclusive limit. Public RSA material must have\nan odd 2048-8192-bit modulus, odd exponent greater than one and smaller than the modulus, and a\nnonzero uint32 key version. Policy ID is a canonical decimal string within uint64. Public documents\nmust have one `data` object, equal canonical tenant IDs, no duplicate keys, aliases, merge keys,\nmultiple documents, float coercion, or conflicting root fields. Known camelCase names normalize to\nsnake_case; supplying both spellings is rejected. Base64 must be canonical.\n\nAccept RSA 2048-8192 and EC P-256/P-384 private keys. Normalize keys to unencrypted PKCS#8 PEM.\nProtected PKCS#8 and modern P12 are native inputs; P12 must contain exactly one private key. Reject\nmixed sources, unmatched pairs, duplicate or unrelated certificates, invalid chain signatures, and\nexpired or future certificates. Locate the matching leaf and order supplied certificates leaf to\nissuer using issuer names and signature verification. Serialize PEM with 64-column base64 and LF\nline endings. A chain may omit its trust root. Check a supplied self-signed root signature.\n\nPublic identity fields are lowercase SHA256 hex: leaf DER fingerprint, SPKI DER identity, and\nnormalized chain PEM identity. Expiration uses UTC RFC3339. Context digest is SHA256 over canonical\nJSON of the array `[public_document, policy_document]`, with recursively sorted object keys, known\naliases normalized, arrays in document order, and exact integer tokens. Preserve every public\npolicy field in that digest so a policy change rotates encryption.\n\nThe reserved `f5-sales-demo.com/blindfold` annotation is a JSON string of:\n\n```json\n{\"version\":1,\"entries\":{\"default\":{\"chain\":\"sha256\",\"spki\":\"sha256\",\"context\":\"sha256\",\"ciphertext\":\"sha256\",\"algorithm\":\"RSA\"}}}\n```\n\nInline IDs must be explicit and unique within the resource. A named certificate defaults to\n`default`. Ciphertext hash covers the exact UTF-8 encrypted location. Never record plaintext keys,\nbundle bytes, passwords, or a private-key hash. Provenance is reconciliation metadata, not\nattestation. Reuse only when its public identities and context match the requested normalized\ninputs, and its chain and ciphertext hash match the actual remote material. Missing or malformed\nprovenance regenerates ciphertext. Reject an in-place RSA/EC algorithm change; require a new\ncertificate/reference cutover. Preserve unrelated metadata and resource options.\n\nTerraform prepares available inputs during planning and encrypts only during apply. Write-only key\nand bundle inputs require `material_version`; secret values never enter state or private state.\nPersist public plan identities and reject changed normalized file material or refreshed context\nwhen applying a saved plan. Refresh context during normal planning; changed context rotates once.\nUnchanged inputs preserve ciphertext across process restart and sequential tool handoff. Import\ndoes not recover private inputs. Observe remote private-key fields and repair drift. Carry the\nserver resource version into one mutation attempt; never retry conflicts. Reconcile accepted or\nuncertain results by named readback. Concurrent ownership is unsupported.\n\nManifest ensure uses a top-level `x-xcsh-blindfold` object with `version: 1` and `certificates`, an\narray of entries containing `id`, `pointer`, `certificate_file` and `private_key_file` or\n`pkcs12_file`, optional `passphrase_env`, and `policy`. JSON pointers point to recognized certificate\nnodes beneath `/spec`; reject unresolved, duplicate, or unsupported pointers. Remove the extension\nbefore API serialization. Private values never enter assistant arguments or reports.\n"},"version":1}
